name: roll posterior shoulder lying on floor
description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the back of the shoulder. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your rear shoulder.
Place the roller under the back of the shoulder and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly along the back of the shoulder.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
